subject: math
question: 设 $1 - a_{i}b_{j}\neq 0(i,j = 1,2,\dots ,n)$ ，计算 $n$ 阶行列式 $D = \left| \begin{array}{ccc}1 - a_1^n b_1^n & \dots & \frac{1 - a_1^n b_n^n}{1 - a_1b_n}\\ \vdots & & \vdots \\ \frac{1 - a_n^n b_1^n}{1 - a_nb_1} & \dots & \frac{1 - a_1^n b_1^n}{1 - a_nb_n} \end{array} \right|$
answer: 1 - a _ {i} ^ {n} b _ {j} ^ {n} = \left(1 - a _ {i} b _ {j}\right) \left(1 + a _ {i} b _ {j} + a _ {i} ^ {2} b _ {j} ^ {2} + \dots + a _ {i} ^ {n} b _ {j} ^ {n}\right) \quad (i, j = 1, 2, \dots , n),

steps.text: 分析 行列式的 $(i,j)$ 元素为 $\frac{1-a_{i}^{n}b_{j}^{n}}{1-a_{i}b_{j}}=1+a_{i}b_{j}+a_{i}^{2}b_{j}^{2}+\cdots+a_{i}^{n}b_{j}^{n}=(1,a_{i},\cdots,a_{i}^{n})\begin{pmatrix}1\\b_{i}\\ \vdots\\b_{i}^{n}\end{pmatrix}$ ，由此可以看出该行列式的矩阵能分解为两个矩阵的乘积.

$$
1 - a _ {i} ^ {n} b _ {j} ^ {n} = \left(1 - a _ {i} b _ {j}\right) \left(1 + a _ {i} b _ {j} + a _ {i} ^ {2} b _ {j} ^ {2} + \dots + a _ {i} ^ {n} b _ {j} ^ {n}\right) \quad (i, j = 1, 2, \dots , n),
$$
